notes.title: Release_ver_2.08.14
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the game would not properly block the start if a specific player had a problem.

Now the game will not start unless all player data is synchronized.

Data will be re-sent up to 3 times (waiting up to 6 seconds), and if synchronization is successful within that, the game will start normally.

Fixed a bug where internal data (tail tag order, assigned souls, clue content) was not being properly initialized during gameplay.



Adjustments
Clue selection process, probability, and content have been adjusted.

Now, after completing a task, you can choose the topic of the clue you receive.

Clue selection must be made within 5 seconds; otherwise, a random clue will be selected.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/619f83a93da8bfc687eba334bef4c8944521941b.png"]

Clue topics (appearance probability):

Target’s Location (10%)

Target’s Relationship (10%)

Chaser’s Location (10%)

Chaser’s Relationship (10%)

Random Soul’s Location (22%)

Random Soul’s Relationship (22%)

Random Info (16%)

Possible clue formats are as follows:

A = Chaser or Target / B = Player Name / C = Soul Name / D = Location / E = Tool

'Location'-related clues:

\[Location] A is currently at D.

\[Location] C is currently at D.

\[Location] A is currently closest to B.

\[Relationship] A is currently B.

\[Relationship] A is currently not B.

\[Relationship] C’s target is B.

\[Relationship] A is either B or B'.

\[Relationship] A is either C or C'.

\[Relationship] B is closest to B'.

\[Relationship] C is closest to B.

\[Relationship] B and B have the most distant relationship.

\[Relationship] C’s ally is either B or B'. (Exclusive to "Who's With You?")

\[Relationship] B is an even number. (Exclusive to "Who's Number?")

\[Relationship] B is an odd number. (Exclusive to "Who's Number?")

\[Other] C is currently holding E.

\[Other] B is currently the richest. (Holding N coins)



New
A commemorative Taegeukgi event skin has been added for August 15th.

You can obtain it by entering the promo code 'KOREA' by August 18th.

Clues
The clue system has been completely overhauled. In the process, several issues with the old system were discovered and fixed. Cases where only specific players received clues or where clue quantities were too low were found to be true.

A bug where base clues could appear repeatedly during routines has been fixed. Unless triggered by special actions, clues now appear only once.

A bug where relationship clues were stored for only one player during routines has been fixed. Now, clues are evenly distributed.

A bug where shop-purchased advanced clues could repeat has been fixed. Once drawn, clues will not reappear unless all are drawn.

Some clues that previously failed to appear have been restored. Currently available clues are as follows:

Adjustments

Soul Balance

 Since version 2.04.07, the dev team has analyzed win rates and average rankings for all souls. Balance adjustments are based on data from approx. 100,000 solo matches.
 Among the 12 souls currently in operation, all (except Preta) maintain a win rate of 20–25% and average rank of 4.1.
 Preta has an 18% win rate and 3.9 average rank. While its ability yields good placement when activated, the low amount of remaining currency and tasks completed suggests players are hiding instead of activating the ability through gameplay. Its ability will be adjusted to improve usability.


Preta

The maximum coin cap (100) has been removed.

Coin requirement calculation changed:
Previous: Number of players × 10
Now: Number of living players × 12


 Tools in the shop can now be locked/unlocked. Locked tools will persist into the next Twilight.
 Options can now be configured from the title screen.
 Title BGM has been adjusted (audio quality and structure optimized).

 A’s initial starting location is D.
 A and B are currently in the same area.
 
 Costume sorting order has been changed.
 Previous: Body < Head < Expression < Robe < Hand < Special
 New: Body < Robe < Head < Expression < Hand < Special
 
 In the [Seal Stamping] task at YeomraPalace, the background color for correct numbers in wrong positions has been changed from yellow to orange. (Temporary colorblind patch)
 *Current colorblind support is a temporary measure. Filter options will be added in the future.


New Features


 The title menu layout has been updated (button selection and SNS access).
 Patch notes can now be accessed from the lobby.
 You can now use the nameplate shop and equip various nameplates.
 
 The current nameplate shop is in test phase and will be continuously improved.
 Each nameplate plays a different sound depending on material.

Adjustments

 Updated Dokkaebi's ability tooltip: “Drops the held tool” → “Uses the held tool”.

Enrag Palace & Confession Hell:
Fill the Water Jar: 14 → 16 coins  
Repair the Platform: 9 → 10 coins

Inspection Hell & Marketplace:
Smuggle Blade Leaf: 12 → 22 coins

New Soul - WhiteLady

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/ce416bde544cb538b0a8ba1d550f56513e95009a.png

WhiteLady is said to have died from heartbreak, unable to confess her love. Even in the afterlife, she continues searching for her beloved. Though she may appear innocent, she often causes trouble around the one she loves. Perhaps all she ever wanted was affection and true love. She longs for reincarnation, perhaps due to the regrets of her past life.

Type: Deduction / Twilight

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/53b6cac147c52d2bc890867fb921370f49d9d328.png

Soul Ability - Obsession

Cooldown: Once per Twilight

If the chosen target is your current goal, their direction will be revealed during the next night.
If you eliminate the target that night, this ability will automatically activate on a new target during the next Twilight.
If you fail to eliminate them, everyone will know you are WhiteLady in the following Twilight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/9b3d67ed51fb503ab8fddf3342e10a3f599075d7.gif


 If the selected target is not your current goal, nothing will happen.
 When Obsession activates, all players are notified, and the nameplate moves to the target's seat.
 When Obsession is active, an effect is shown around the target, visible only to WhiteLady.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/526ee72b23a9d67599272383be310d55dc0b155a.gif


 If the target selected with Obsession dies from another cause (e.g., Sudden Death, Sackman, Gumiho), the next target will not be selected automatically.
 In Live and Die Together mode, Obsession will not trigger on teammates — only on your goal.
 If used consecutively in Live and Die Together mode, it will randomly activate on one player from the new target group.
 The ability is disabled when only two players remain.
 If stunned or kidnapped, the target indicator may temporarily disappear.
 If Headcrusher’s ability “Delirium” is activated, WhiteLady’s Obsession is canceled and must be reused.
 If “Delirium” is used but the target remains the same, the ability is not canceled.

notes.title: Who's Next? Dev LoadMap - 2025 2Q
notes.content:
Greetings, Souls of the Afterlife!
We are HellAssociation, the developers of Who's Next?

Since our Early Access launch on February 28, 2025, more than 4,000 souls have joined the slaughter in Who's Next? over the past month. We sincerely thank all of you who have ventured into the afterlife.

This announcement outlines the tentative development schedule for Who's Next? in the second quarter of 2025 (April – June).

We’ll share what we currently have planned for each month so that you can anticipate what’s coming next. 🙂

Thank you again for playing Who's Next?

Sincerely,
The HellAssociation Team

April
During April, we’ll be focusing on resolving lingering bugs and further optimizing the game. While there won’t be many new content updates this month, please understand that this is a preparatory phase to ensure the stability of upcoming content. All updates in April will primarily focus on bug fixes.

2nd Week of April – Minor bug fix update, language pack revision (Japanese / English / Chinese) – integrated patch

3rd Week of April – [Regular Update] New content release (Could it be… the 12th soul?)

4th Week of April – Minor bug fix update, AI player function added (tentative), nameplate skins enabled, new nameplate items added!

May
In May, major new content will start rolling out. Look forward to new souls, new tools, and fresh, strategic game modes!

1st Week of May – [Regular Update] Major content update (Tool overhaul + new tools / Children’s Day Event)

3rd Week of May – Minor update

4th Week of May – 2025 PlayX4 Exhibition (Look forward to Who's Next? merch at our B2C booth!)

Regular updates will be postponed during this week due to event operations.

June
In June, we’ll begin testing for the mobile version of Who's Next?
We’ll be recruiting beta testers, and those selected will receive special rewards for helping us test.

1st Week of June – [Regular Update] New content release (Could it be… the 13th soul?)

3rd Week of June – First round of mobile platform testing

 Some abilities now have more detailed tooltips. (GangChul, Preta)

 Clues
* The base power of standard clues has been slightly increased. To adjust the game tempo, the default setting for *Unlucky Day* has been changed to ON. (The default value has been adjusted so that players can collect approximately 2-3 meaningful clues per round.)
* Clues that were too difficult to interpret or were too ambiguous have been modified. (* A - Player name / B - Spirit name)

 A has never purchased a tool. → Removed.
 A has used their spirit ability N times. → Removed.

 A and B have the closest relationship. → A and B are either each other’s target or hunter. (Terminology change)
 B and A have the closest relationship. → A and B are either each other’s target or hunter. (Terminology change)

 The default setting for *Unlucky Day* (which allows meaningless clues to appear) has been changed from OFF to ON.
 The probability of meaningless clues appearing in *Unlucky Day* has been adjusted. - 30% → 20%

 GangChul
 GangChul is designed as a last-minute comeback character. However, due to various external debuffs, there have been frequent cases where GangChul could not defeat enemies even after transforming at a high cost. To ensure GangChul can eliminate at least 1-2 opponents after transformation, movement speed has been increased.

 The movement speed increase of GangChul’s ability [Ascension] has been adjusted.

[New Content]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/301352bce7d9df2eeb715d0797160b327eac507d.png
New Spirit - SackMan

SackMan, known for abducting disobedient children, is quite a notorious figure even in the living world. The reason for his relentless kidnappings remains unknown, but it is said that his sack contains all sorts of bizarre creatures and cruel tools.  
And what happens to the children trapped inside? …Let’s not imagine that.


 Type: Offensive / Utility
 This spirit can eliminate enemies regardless of target relationships, but the process takes time.  
 Abducted players can do nothing but scream for help. The only way to escape is using [Flame Heart], so use your strategy wisely.  
 Movement speed decreases significantly for each abducted player, so be cautious of your hunters before you process your captives.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/a7be8454fa051fe53c242b6b438dd788fab2494c.png

 Spirit Ability - I'm Coming for You~!
 Cooldown: 30 seconds


Instantly abducts the nearest opponent and traps them in SackMan’s sack.  
Movement speed decreases by 20% for each abducted opponent.  
If this state is maintained for 44 seconds, the trapped opponents are eliminated one by one.

* SackMan’s Perspective

* Abducted Player’s Perspective

 While abducted, players cannot dash, move, use tools, or activate abilities (including Twilight-type abilities).
 If an abducted player enters Twilight, they can still access the shop.
 The 44-second timer for the abducted state only progresses during day and night.
 Players who are still alive can continue to communicate with others during Twilight.

Clues

- [Clues] are the most impactful element of the game system. To improve game longevity, the amount of unlocked information has been reduced in previous updates. However, for games with 8 or more players, this made gameplay overly difficult. Clues have been reworked to reveal more information, encouraging discussions and sharing among players. notes.title: Game Preview - Who's Next?
notes.content:
Overview

Who's Next? is a social deduction game similar to Among Us and Goose Goose Duck.  
It is currently playable with a minimum of 4 players and a maximum of 8 players.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/b1d49b9ee3e705d718701f3c35a546da6af0376c.png

However, what sets it apart from existing games is that everyone is both a crewmate and an imposter in a “tail chase structure.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/56d8035b33bbc57fd63f1a37bb9d5d1f4d4e5a12.png

We developed this rule to address issues in existing games, such as "Why am I never the imposter!" or one specific troll player reducing the overall fun of the game.

Gameplay – Souls and Objectives

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/0701ec40f52ef357a9575008c84969c7742a790d.png

The game begins by assigning players a unique, random soul and the soul they need to target.

At first, you don’t know who possesses which soul, but as the game progresses, you can collect clues and partial information while engaging in dialogue to deduce others' souls.

There are two main ways to deduce each other's souls:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/0ff3825112be0aac1b8e81c4ea31b84d81eac5ec.png  
1. Performing Tasks (mini-games) to collect accurate clues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/8389efc46f4f46c571b55cbce83b547889267764.png  
2. Using proximity-based in-game voice chat or discussing during “Twilight Time” to gather information.

Once you figure out who holds the target soul you're after, you can attempt to eliminate (Space) them at close range, similar to existing games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/291fa27e1019852a05871bda07ba92f634838fc8.gif

If you attempt to eliminate the wrong target, you will die, so be cautious!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/413f9a697c6aaf841e3e48097cec3c1b8bd06507.gif

Take down all your targets in order, and you’ll be the last one standing to claim victory!

Gameplay – Tasks and Strategic Tools

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/f9810bf397ec018be8895f7d8a1c66406c2a086c.gif

By completing Tasks (mini-games) throughout the afterlife, you can collect clues and earn a currency called Yeopjeon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/8b0d64e0a9acf5a853796233bb16845a2abfe9a4.gif

You can use the Yeopjeon you’ve earned to purchase various strategic tools from the shop.  
Depending on your situation and the game’s progress, utilizing the right tools can help you gain an advantage.

The price of tools varies based on their grade and ability. Some tools can even turn the tide of the game or perform exceptionally well depending on your soul and circumstances.

Game Concept – Traditional Korean Afterlife

This game embraces a distinctly Korean theme. All in-game concepts are set against the backdrop of a battle for reincarnation in the traditional Korean afterlife, featuring ghosts and spirits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/4129698dec5c83e36565ac363b003972af7323fe.gif

*Synopsis: Who’s Next? Emergency Edition

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/078a9ad0978f8d969b055588c771fe9928077e36.png

The year is 2024… There are too many souls awaiting judgment in the afterlife.  
It seems they’re on a hellish tour due to the many sins they’ve committed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/20b3e1c3274ea0cd4988029290d43342721386fa.gif

At this rate, the overloaded afterlife will collapse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/2053d3790185a3bae83da8013f29561aa038af6d.gif

What was that? Did the ground just sink beneath us? This is a truly dangerous situation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44940572/8c185533d2f93db6f5a7b038ef662e62c98eef15.gif

Our great, wise, amazing, and perfect… King Yeomra had no choice but to implement the Emergency Soul Reduction Policy, [Who’s Next?].

“Kill each other! The last survivor will be promised reincarnation without question!”

[Who’s Next?] spread across the afterlife instantly, and the desperate battle for reincarnation among sinners began!

notes.content:
October 26 Demo Update Notice

Hello,

This is HellAssociation, the developers of Who's Next?.

Below is a list of bug fixes and balance patches based on bugs found over about ten days since the demo release. There are quite a few bug fixes, so if you're only interested in gameplay updates, you can skip ahead to the [Adjustments] section below.

Thank you for your patience as we continue to improve the game.

---
[Bug and Feature Fixes List]

In-Game Fixes

- Fixed incorrect clue code display when obtaining general clues; 'STR_TASK_FIREHELLSMELTING_NAME' now appears correctly.
- New “blank” clues have been added. Watch out for unrelated clues like "Next time..." / "Short ribs recipe..." / "Miss you, Miss…" which have no connection to the target relationships.
- The label for "Advanced Clues" has changed from "Goal of XX at Start" to "Current Goal of XX."
- Fixed a bug where items purchased from the shop and used immediately remained after the shop time expired.
- Fixed a bug where Dokkaebi tools were visible to everyone during twilight.
- Fixed a bug where items purchased by other players were not visible during twilight.
- When it becomes pitch dark, the direction of the last remaining opponent is now visible.
- Fixed a bug where dead players were visible to living players.
- Fixed a bug where the appearance of a deceased player (Dummy Amulet!) persisted even after the game ended.
- Fixed an issue where spirits of already deceased players did not follow the 'X' marker when Headcrusher's ‘Mental Confusion’ ability was used.
- Fixed an issue where the current objective guide text did not change when Headcrusher's ‘Mental Confusion’ ability was used.
- Now, when the Dokkaebi cloak tool is used for stealth, debuff markers are no longer visible to other players. (Perfect Dark Templar)
- Fixed a bug where, if you purchased a second *Scroll : SPEED* while already holding it, the speed buff would disappear.

Other UI and UX Fixes
Tutorial dialogue was updated to show the movement keys as "W A S D" instead of "W S A D."
Corrected typos and inaccurate terms in tutorial dialogues.
The tutorial’s spirit guide tab now includes a preview of tools used by specific spirits (such as Dokkaebi and Preta).
Updated the “Spirit Trial Mode” in the tutorial so that objectives can change based on items/abilities.
Improved UI interaction when settings or help are open, making it clearer which UI elements are disabled.
Enhanced the game-end sound effect to celebrate victory. (Let the music play~!)
The victory screen now shows the spirits alongside the nicknames of deceased players.
In Observer Mode (deceased state), the items held by surviving players are now displayed beside their names.
The room host can now force players to leave from the Waiting Room’s options panel (General tab, Waiting Room players section).
Sound effects now play when using abilities of Reaper, Shapeshifter Rat, and Dark Shikini.

Tasks
Improved responsiveness when polishing grave headstones. (Now you don’t have to scrub so hard.)
Enhanced responsiveness when interacting with the scarecrow. (It’s…spooky…)
Fixed a bug where completing the talisman drawing task was possible without tracing the lines.
Fixed a distortion issue with the name display when incense was burned on a spirit headstone.
Incense burning now visibly produces smoke when completed on a spirit headstone.
Fixed a bug where the incense task would award multiple rewards upon completion.
Players can no longer complete tasks after death unless the “Chang-Gwi” option is enabled.
Spirits unable to perform tasks during the night will no longer see task location markers on the map (X marker).
Fixed an issue with intermittent clicks failing on the “Forge the Trident” task.
Increased the reward currency for tasks with longer completion times.

Voice Chat Fixes
Improved the quality of voice chat audio.
Fixed a bug where players could hear each other’s voices for a few seconds at the start of a game.
Fixed an issue where selected microphone devices in options were not applying correctly.
Fixed an issue where the microphone could not be turned back on after leaving and re-entering the waiting room while muted.

Character Skin Fixes
Fixed a bug where repeated interactions with the wardrobe key would prevent character movement.
Fixed an issue where head costume resets failed when entering a different room after equipping it in the previous waiting room.
The wardrobe UI has been completely revamped.
New exclusive skins that were previously unavailable have been added. They are free to use in the demo version!
The 2024 Halloween Event has arrived! Check out the special Halloween skins in the new wardrobe (see image below).

[Adjustments]

Spirit Balance Adjustments

- Headcrusher: Oh, My Head!

Headcrusher’s ability, ‘Mental Confusion,’ is designed as an obstacle to prolong the game and challenge other players’ deductions. However, during the last demo, it caused more headaches than anticipated. 
 - The cooldown for Headcrusher’s ability ‘Mental Confusion’ has been adjusted:
60 seconds → 300 seconds

- Dokkaebi: Extra! Extra!
The Dokkaebi’s mystical tool, ‘Great News,’ forces all spirits to reveal themselves. To maintain its power while not overly exposing other players’ information, the spawn rate has been adjusted. 
 - Spawn rate adjustments for Dokkaebi’s “Dokkaebi Club” tool:
Endless Bag (20% → 20%)
Dokkaebi Statue (20% → 25%)
Dizzying Club (20% → 25%)
Dokkaebi Cloak (20% → 25%)
Great News (20% → 5%)

- Reaper: Is this correct?
The Reaper’s ‘Life and Death Scroll’ can position the chosen player accurately at dusk, ensuring clarity for the user’s position. 
 - Targets affected by Reaper’s ability now have fixed nameplates that cannot be moved.

- Preta: Promised Level 100
Preta is a high-risk, high-reward spirit. While initially limited to bluffing, it is designed to benefit from collecting 100 coins. However, in the last demo, Preta often became a public target upon reaching this threshold. 
 - Adjusted effects upon activation of Preta’s ability:
Preta’s identity is now hidden upon activation (name and “Endless Hunger” indicator are not visible to other players).
Preta now appears more “feral” in the Frenzy state (camera effects added).

Tool Balance Adjustments
- Speed Is Power - Ever Been Cut at the Speed of Light? 
 - Grade and price adjustments for Scroll : SPEED: 
- Grade: Low → Special 
- Average Price: 8 coins → 37 coins

- Lucky RNG Game 
 - Probability adjustments for tools obtained from Mystery Luggage: 
- Low-grade: 30% 
- Mid-grade: 40% 
- High-grade: 25% 
- Special-grade: 5%
